# Butler v0.0.10

## Change Log

- Reduced the default startup tool surface so basic project turns expose a
  bounded app profile instead of the full native tool registry.
- Removed weather tools from the native Butler registry, runtime executor,
  startup profiles, and default app suggestions.
- Refactored native tools into grouped tool folders under
  `agent/tools/{tool-group-name}/{tool-name}` with per-tool definition,
  executor, and index entrypoints.
- Preserved provider-visible tool names while moving shared execution helpers
  into `agent/tool-support`.
- Hardened `run_command` artifact evidence so workspace files are promoted only
  when they are explicitly declared through output paths.
- Normalized worker runtime tool behavior so worker sessions keep bounded,
  role-limited tool profiles.
- Updated regression coverage for startup tool profiles, weather removal,
  native tool folder ownership, and `run_command` artifact evidence.
